title: Bits of the reduction string
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, $c_0$ a natural number, $x$ a bit string, and $i$ a natural number. Write $n$ for the number of vertices in the reduction and $L=2n$. The bit at position $i$ of the reduction string, taking an out-of-range bit to be false, equals true for $i<L$, equals false at $i=L$, equals true at $i=L+1$, equals the edge indicator at row $((i-(L+2))/2)/n$ and column $((i-(L+2))/2)\bmod n$ when $i-(L+2)<2n^2$, and otherwise equals the bit at position $i-(L+2)-2n^2$ of the five-bit tail $[0,1,0,1,1]$, with out-of-range tail bits false.
